data.title: Khanna to introduce 'Data Center Bill of Rights' as fight over AI power plants heats up
data.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, who won a competitive primary Tuesday, has endorsed state and local moratoriums on data centers.
